symptom: Pricing entitlement parity was merged to main as tests/learning/docs only, so the production release controller correctly classified that merge as non-deployment and did not publish a new site deploy.
root_cause: The user explicitly requested a fresh live deployment after the non-deployment parity merge.
The repository production controller only deploys when production-relevant website content changes.
fix: Add an explicit inert production-promotion marker to prijzen.html so the governed website lane performs a fresh Netlify deployment of the current main state.
Require exact deploy identity and public /prijzen readback before calling the promotion live.
prevention: When a user explicitly requests a fresh production deploy after a non-deployment-only merge, use a governed inert website promotion marker instead of claiming the previous deploy already contains the new merge SHA.
Never claim LIVE until the deployed SHA and affected public route are verified.
evidence: PR delivery and production readback for this lineage
